headline: Maruti delivered its volume growth and capex targets during the period, while medium-term capacity and charging network goals remain pending.

promises.promise: Volume growth of over 10% this year compared to last year
promises.quote: The broad expectation , which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year.
promises.evidence: FY26 sales grew by 19.9% versus the previous year.

promises.promise: Increase production capacity to 4 million units per annum
promises.quote: Besides, the company has put plans in place to increase the production capacity to 4 million units per annum in the medium term.
promises.evidence: Medium-term horizon has not ended yet.

promises.promise: INR 14,000 crores capex for the full year FY 26-27
promises.quote: Overall, on the capex for FY 26-27, we are looking at a INR 14,000 crores capex for the full year.
promises.evidence: Horizon for FY 26-27 has not ended yet.

promises.promise: Enable over 1 lakh charging points by 2030
promises.quote: Aligned with Suzuki's global vision, we plan to introduce multiple EVs and to support this, our aim is to enable a network of over 1 lakh charging points across India by 2030, along with our dealers and charge point operators.
promises.evidence: Target horizon is by 2030, which has not arrived yet.

promises.promise: Additional volume of about 250,000 cars this year over previous year
promises.quote: Effectively, one can expect that we'll have an additional volume of about 250,000 cars available th is year over the previous year.
promises.evidence: FY26 sales increased by over 30 million vehicles compared to FY25.

shifts.change: Management provided detailed guidance in Q4 FY26 but gave no guidance during the subsequent Q2 FY27 call.
